labelling.labelledBy: Claude (AI), from the source at the pinned commit
labelling.method: A separate Python script (not the CodeAtlas adapter) read every non-test .ts file under server/src that imports @nestjs/common: the @Controller argument (a string literal or a RouteKey member resolved from server/src/enum.ts), each member-level verb decorator and the next method name. Every decorator argument was a string literal or empty; none needed manual resolution. Eleven verb and path pairs appear twice because MaintenanceWorkerController serves the same routes in the maintenance worker; both handlers are labelled. Awaiting founder spot-check (decision D-9). Imports (TS-001, added 2026-11-15): a separate Python script (regexes over the source, not CodeAtlas code) labelled 558 imports in 108 files. Its first run disagreed with CodeAtlas on 12 pairs; on reading the source, 2 were labeller errors (it did not apply packages/cli tsconfig paths, and it counted a type-position import('svelte')), which were fixed in the script, and 1 was a CodeAtlas defect (a $app/... specifier rewritten as a Svelte store read), which was fixed in CodeAtlas.

scope.rule: One relationship per HTTP verb and path declared with a NestJS verb decorator on a method of an @Controller class, to that method; controller prefix joined; the global prefix (api, set in app.common.ts) is not included.

One relationship per (file, target) for every static import, export-from and literal dynamic import() in non-test .ts, .js and .svelte files (script blocks) under these folders. The target is the repository file it loads (relative paths with extensions and index files tried, a .js specifier also matching its .ts source; tsconfig paths; package.json imports such as #lib/*; a workspace package's source, mapped from its built entry through its tsconfig outDir and rootDir), node:<name> for a Node built-in, @sveltejs/kit for $app/* and $env/*, and otherwise the npm package name. A bundler query such as ?url is ignored.
